en: A hand-tinted photograph of a small city with colorful roofs and mid-century buildings, nestled between a waterfront and distant rolling hills. The foreground features a round fountain and a park with tree-lined paths. In the lower center, a gas station with a red sign reading 'GULF' is visible. The town has a distinctly Nordic look, with modest multi-story residential buildings, a large body of water, and subdued colors typical of Scandinavian design.
